title: Designing Human-mediated AI Guidance: Ready Together for Personalized Family Emergency Preparedness
abstract: arXiv:2608.19950v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems are increasingly used across domains to provide personalized information, recommendations, and decision support. However, in some contexts, AI-generated information may not be suitable for direct delivery to the final recipient. Instead, it may need to be interpreted, adapted, and communicated by a human who understands the recipient's needs, emotional state, and situational context. Human-AI interaction research has given less attention to situations in which a more knowledgeable human acts as an intermediary between an AI system and a less experienced or less informed recipient. We introduce the human-mediated AI guidance framework and explore it through Ready Together, an AI-supported family emergency preparedness system in which parents mediate AI-generated content for their children. translated_title: 设计人介导的AI指导：共同为个性化家庭应急准备做好准备
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19950v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：人工智能（AI）系统在各领域中越来越多地被用于提供个性化信息、建议和决策支持。然而，在某些情境下，AI生成的信息可能不适合直接传递给最终接收者。相反，它可能需要由一位理解接收者需求、情绪状态和情境背景的人类进行解读、调整和传达。人机交互研究较少关注这样一种情况：一位知识更丰富的人类在AI系统和经验较少或信息较少的接收者之间充当中间人。我们提出了人介导的AI指导框架，并通过“Ready Together”这一AI支持的家庭应急准备系统进行探索，在该系统中，父母为子女介导AI生成的内容。该系统旨在提供个性化指导，并支持父母使应急准备更加...
tldr: 本文提出了一种人介导的AI指导框架，通过家庭应急准备系统“Ready Together”展示了AI内容需由人类中介者（如父母）根据接收者需求进行适配传递的关键创新。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a human-mediated AI guidance framework, demonstrated through the family emergency preparedness system "Ready Together," highlighting the innovation that AI-generated content requires human intermediaries (e.g., parents) to adapt delivery based on recipients' needs.
